definition: Xiaomi MiMo is a family of large language models (LLMs) developed by Xiaomi.
details: It was initially released in April 2025 with the MiMo-7B model. Currently, MiMo is available for developers through API service. It is used as the key AI model in Xiaomi's "Human x Car x Home" ecosystem.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Xiaomi MiMo — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
